The Journey

The Founder Story: From Quizmasters to Pioneers.

Established 2014 • Bengaluru, India

“Why does learning stop being fun when kids enter the classroom?”

In 2014, two national-level quizmasters and TEDx speakers—Sachin Ravi and Raghavan A.—noticed a striking pattern across India. While young children naturally ask hundreds of questions a day, traditional rote-memorization schooling slowly systematically turns off that spark.

They started QShala to prove that general knowledge shouldn't be about memorizing static encyclopedia facts for marks. Instead, it should be an active, socratic sport—full of stories, curiosity clubs, real-world current affairs, and friendly team quests.

Over the past decade, QShala has grown from weekend curiosity circles into an ecosystem partnering with 250+ premier K-12 schools and 80+ global corporates, impacting over 150,000+ learners across 18+ cities.

“
“Our vision is simple: to nurture an empathetic, highly curious generation that never stops asking 'Why?'”
— Sachin & Raghavan, Co-Founders
